highlights: Get fixes without a store update: when a fix is ready, the home screen shows A new OpenBot is ready. Tap Update and the app restarts with the fix.
Attach MOV or MP4 videos from Photos, and search the model list in agent settings and Create agent.
New provider pages: add an API key for ChatGPT and Claude, choose a default provider for new agents, and sign in through the browser.
Give a channel its own picture, and get a notification when an agent finishes or stops with an error in a thread. The server needs the new OpenBot version.
Connect Postiz from the Apps marketplace so agents can draft, schedule and publish social media posts.
